A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XX · the canid family (and the bears)

Canids

Four canid and bear monster girls: the wolf and her pack, the great white polar bear, the bamboo-loving panda and Anubis, jackal of the desert tombs. Loyal, strong, and kin to the beasts of the vanilla world.

Favourite food: Meat; the wolf loves bones, the panda bamboo

The central similarity

Kin to the beasts.

Every one of them has vanilla kin, except Anubis, who keeps the dead: wolves, polar bears and pandas follow her and trust whoever she trusts.

  • PackThe wolf runs with a pack led by its alpha.
  • HuntThe wolf and the polar bear hunt while wild.
  • NatureThe panda is born with a personality, like vanilla pandas.
  • JudgementAnubis weighs your heart against the feather.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a canid builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Meat (+2); bones for the wolf (+3), bamboo for the panda (+2), fish for the polar bear (+2)
  • Petting

What costs trust

  • Hitting her
  • For Anubis: killing villagers or iron golems

Devoted (60+)

Her kin are yours: wolves, polar bears and pandas near her trust you.

Mating & young

FormLive young. YoungPups or cubs, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed.
2. PupsA day later she bears a litter of pups or cubs.
3. YoungHer young stay by their mother.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

PackWolves spawn in packs. The first is the alpha and the others follow her; wild, they hunt sheep and rabbits.
Wolf kinA befriended wolf girl's tamed wolves join her fights.
Polar huntA wild polar bear hunts seal mermaids and penguin harpies, fishes at open water and guards her cubs.
PersonalityPandas are lazy, worried, playful, aggressive, weak or normal; a playful one rolls, a weak one sneezes.
The weighingAnubis weighs every player who comes near: those who killed villagers or iron golems are condemned and hunted; light hearts may open the tomb chests she guards.

Species profiles

Taiga & forestsLoyal · pack-minded

Wolf (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentLoyal, proud, pack-minded

Ecology & behaviourCanis lupus (Carnivora: Canidae). She runs with a pack led by its alpha, and kin of the vanilla wolves.

Signature: Pack hunterWild, her pack hunts sheep and rabbits. Befriended, your tamed wolves join her fights. She howls at night.

Player interactionBones. Never come between her and her pack.

Polar Bear (about 2.2 blocks)

TemperamentCalm, mighty, fiercely protective

Signature: Ice hunterWild, she hunts seal mermaids and penguin harpies. She fishes at open water, and attacks anyone near her cubs.

Panda (about 1.75 blocks)

TemperamentBorn with a personality

Ecology & behaviourAiluropoda melanoleuca (Carnivora: Ursidae). A bear who eats almost nothing but bamboo, and sleeps a lot.

Anubis (about 1.95 blocks)

TemperamentSolemn, just, merciless to the guilty

Ecology & behaviourThe jackal-headed guardian of Egyptian tombs, who weighs the hearts of the dead against the feather of Ma'at. Her jackal is the golden jackal (Canis aureus).

Signature: The weighingShe weighs every player who comes near. Anyone who killed villagers or iron golems is condemned and hunted. Others may open the tomb chests she guards.

Player interactionCome with a clean conscience. Bread and honey as offerings.

Caves & mountainsEager · nose for ore

Kobold (about 1.35 blocks)

TemperamentEager, nosy, loyal

Ecology & behaviourThe mine spirit of German folklore, who gave cobalt its name, here a little dog-girl miner in a helmet.

Signature: Nose for oreBefriended, she sniffs out the nearest diamond, gold or emerald ore and points the way. She yelps when the block you look at holds up sand or gravel, and she smells mimics: a mimic chest near her rattles.

Player interactionBring her meat or bones and take her mining.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Wolf: packs with an alpha, hunts sheep and rabbits while wild, bones, leads her player's tamed wolves into her fights, howls at night
  • Polar bear: hunts seal mermaids and penguin harpies while wild, fishes at open water, guards her cubs
  • Panda: a personality from birth (lazy, worried, playful, aggressive, weak, normal), bamboo, sneezes slimeballs
  • Anubis: weighs each player's heart (villager and iron golem kills); condemns and hunts the guilty; guards tomb chests from the unjudged
  • Kin: wolves, polar bears and pandas
  • Live young
  • Cu sith: at her third bark the monsters near her friend flee. Yeti: snowballs at the monsters near her friend, now and then a snow golem; never freezes
  • Meloncollie: befriended, herds stray cows, sheep, pigs and chickens to the nearest fence gate; plants melon seeds in empty farmland
  • Black bear: climbs trees, eats ripe berry bushes bare, and runs from sprinting strangers, explosions, bells and goat horns (once befriended, only explosions)

Not yet

  • Kobolds

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Bears share the canid family (2026-10-24). The wolf is her own species, not a kobold.

Open questions

  • Kobolds: a sixth canid later?
